12-## Bookmarks
13-
14-### `GET /api/bookmarks`
15-List/search bookmarks. Query params:
16-- `q` — advanced search string (see search-grammar.md). Optional.
17-- `tag` — repeatable; simple tag filter (equivalent to `#tag` AND terms).
18:- `view` — saved-view id (applies its query + include/exclude tags).
19-- `scope` — `active` (default, excludes archived), `unread`, `archived`, `all`.
20-- `sort` — one of the sort keys (FR-010); defaults to preference.
21-- `page`, `pageSize` — pagination; `pageSize` default from preferences.
22-
23-Response: `{ items: Bookmark[], total, page, pageSize }`. Each `Bookmark`
24:includes display title/description (override applied), tags, favicon/preview
25-refs, read/archived flags, `captureStatus`, dates, and snapshot/archive refs.
26-Malformed `q` → `400` with a clear message (FR-013).
27-
28-### `POST /api/bookmarks`
29-Create a bookmark. Body: `{ url, title?, description?, note?, tags?[], unread? }`.
30-- Normalizes and validates `url` (FR-004).
31-- If `url_key` already exists → `409` with `{ existingId }`; the client navigates
32-  to that bookmark for editing (FR-007/US-2). No duplicate created.

57-## Bulk actions
58-
59-### `POST /api/bookmarks/bulk`
60:Body: `{ selector, action }`.
61:- `selector` = `{ ids: string[] }` **or** `{ match: {...} }` to act on all
62:  bookmarks matching the current view (FR-019, "select all matching"). The
63-  `match` object accepts the **exact same criteria as `GET /api/bookmarks`** —
64:  `q`, `tag[]`, `view`, `scope` — and is resolved through the **same query
65:  builder** used for listing. In particular, when `view` (a saved-view id) is
66-  supplied, its stored query **and** its included/excluded tags are applied in
67:  full, so a bulk action affects every bookmark matching the complete saved view,
68-  not just the visible page and not only the text/simple-tag portion (FR-019,
69-  US-9 scenario 2a). The server computes the affected set from these criteria
70-  server-side (ignoring pagination), guaranteeing parity with what the list
71-  shows.
72-- `action` = one of:
73-  - `{ type: "addTags", tags: string[] }`
74-  - `{ type: "removeTags", tags: string[] }`
75-  - `{ type: "setUnread", unread: boolean }`
